alt.zh-CN: 图像描述，同时作为可预览缩略图的读屏名称。
alt.en-US: Image description, also the accessible name of a previewable thumbnail.

children.zh-CN: 组件不渲染该属性，设置后无效。
children.en-US: Not rendered by the component, so setting it has no effect.

className.en-US: Class name of the thumbnail root element.

crossOrigin.zh-CN: 透传给原生 img 标签的 crossOrigin，可选 `anonymous` 或 `use-credentials`。设置后预览图片也使用同一值，未设置时预览图片取 `preview.crossOrigin`。
crossOrigin.en-US: The crossOrigin passed to the native img element, `anonymous` or `use-credentials`. When set, the preview image uses the same value; otherwise it uses `preview.crossOrigin`.

fallback.zh-CN: 加载失败时显示的内容：字符串作为容错图片地址，React 元素原样显示；未设置时显示默认的加载失败图标。
fallback.en-US: Content shown when loading fails: a string is the fallback image URL, and a React element is shown as it is. Without it, the default failure icon is shown.

height.zh-CN: 图片显示高度，数值按 px 处理。
height.en-US: Display height of the image; a number is in px.

imgCls.zh-CN: 自定义样式类名，透传给 img 节点。
imgCls.en-US: Custom class name passed to the img element.

imgStyle.zh-CN: 自定义样式，透传给 img 节点。
imgStyle.en-US: Custom style passed to the img element.

onClick.zh-CN: 点击图片时调用，绑定在内部的 img 节点上。
onClick.en-US: Called when the image is clicked; bound to the inner img element.

placeholder.zh-CN: 图片加载成功前显示的占位内容；未设置时显示骨架屏。
placeholder.en-US: Placeholder content shown until the image has loaded; without it, a skeleton is shown.

preview.zh-CN: 预览参数，为 false 时禁用预览。对象接受 ImagePreview 的属性，但不含 lazyLoad、lazyLoadMargin、children、className 与 style（预览样式请用 previewCls、previewStyle）。
preview.en-US: Preview options; false disables the preview. The object accepts the ImagePreview props except lazyLoad, lazyLoadMargin, children, className and style (use previewCls and previewStyle to style the preview).

ref.zh-CN: 内部 img 元素的引用。
ref.en-US: Reference to the inner img element.

setDownloadName.zh-CN: 设置图片下载文件名，接收图片地址并返回文件名。
setDownloadName.en-US: Sets the download file name: receives the image URL and returns the file name.

style.en-US: Style of the thumbnail root element.

width.zh-CN: 图片显示宽度，数值按 px 处理。
width.en-US: Display width of the image; a number is in px.

adaptiveTip.zh-CN: 适应页面操作按钮的提示；未设置时取语言包的文案。
adaptiveTip.en-US: Tip of the fit-to-page button; without it, the locale text is used.

children.zh-CN: 要预览的 Image 组件。

className.zh-CN: 分组根 div 的类名。
className.en-US: Class name of the group root div.

closable.en-US: Whether to show the close button.

closeOnEsc.zh-CN: 按下 Esc 键时是否关闭预览，默认 `true`。
closeOnEsc.en-US: Whether pressing Esc closes the preview, `true` by default.

crossOrigin.zh-CN: 透传给预览图片的原生 img 标签的 crossOrigin，可选 `anonymous` 或 `use-credentials`。
crossOrigin.en-US: The crossOrigin passed to the native img element of the preview image, `anonymous` or `use-credentials`.

currentIndex.zh-CN: 受控属性，当前预览图片下标。
currentIndex.en-US: Controlled index of the current preview image.

defaultCurrentIndex.en-US: Index of the image shown initially.

defaultVisible.en-US: Whether the preview is open initially.

disableDownload.zh-CN: 禁用下载；没有当前图片（`src` 为空列表）时下载按钮同样禁用。
disableDownload.en-US: Disables downloads; the download button is also disabled when there is no current image (an empty src list).

downloadTip.zh-CN: 下载操作按钮的提示；未设置时取语言包的文案。
downloadTip.en-US: Tip of the download button; without it, the locale text is used.

getPopupContainer.zh-CN: 指定预览渲染的父级 DOM，返回 `document.body` 与不传相同。容器不是 `document.body` 时预览为非模态，自定义容器需要设置 `position: relative`。
getPopupContainer.en-US: Parent DOM the preview renders into; returning `document.body` is the same as not passing it. A container other than `document.body` makes the preview non-modal, and a custom container needs `position: relative`.

infinite.zh-CN: 是否无限循环切换，默认 `false`。
infinite.en-US: Whether switching wraps around infinitely, `false` by default.

initialZoom.zh-CN: 预览图片初始缩放比例，仅在首次打开或切换到该图片时生效一次，会被 minZoom 与 maxZoom 限制。
initialZoom.en-US: Initial zoom factor of a preview image, applied once when it first opens or is switched to, clamped by minZoom and maxZoom.

lazyLoad.zh-CN: 是否开启懒加载，相对视口判断；设了 overflow 的滚动祖先仍会裁剪。
lazyLoad.en-US: Whether to enable lazy loading, judged against the viewport; a scrolling ancestor with overflow still clips.

lazyLoadMargin.zh-CN: 传给 IntersectionObserver 的 rootMargin，相对视口计算。
lazyLoadMargin.en-US: The rootMargin passed to IntersectionObserver, computed against the viewport.

maskClosable.zh-CN: 点击遮罩是否可关闭预览，默认 `true`。
maskClosable.en-US: Whether clicking the mask closes the preview, `true` by default.

maxZoom.zh-CN: 预览图片最大缩放比例，如 `5` 表示 500%，默认 `5`。
maxZoom.en-US: Maximum zoom factor of a preview image, such as `5` for 500%, `5` by default.

minZoom.zh-CN: 预览图片最小缩放比例，如 `0.1` 表示 10%，默认 `0.1`。
minZoom.en-US: Minimum zoom factor of a preview image, such as `0.1` for 10%, `0.1` by default.

nextTip.zh-CN: 下一张操作按钮的提示，同时作为读屏名称；未设置时取语言包的文案。
nextTip.en-US: Tip of the next-image button, also its accessible name; without it, the locale text is used.

onChange.zh-CN: 切换图片时调用，参数为新的图片下标。
onChange.en-US: Called when the image switches, with the new index.

onClose.zh-CN: 点击关闭按钮或按 Esc 关闭预览时调用；点击遮罩关闭只触发 onVisibleChange，不调用 onClose。
onClose.en-US: Called when the preview is closed with the close button or Esc; closing by the mask only calls onVisibleChange, not onClose.

onDownload.zh-CN: 下载图片时调用，参数为图片地址与下标。
onDownload.en-US: Called when an image is downloaded, with its URL and index.

onDownloadError.zh-CN: 图片下载失败时调用，参数为图片地址。
onDownloadError.en-US: Called when a download fails, with the image URL.

onNext.zh-CN: 向后切换图片时调用，参数为切换后的下标。
onNext.en-US: Called when switching to the next image, with the new index.

onPrev.zh-CN: 向前切换图片时调用，参数为切换后的下标。
onPrev.en-US: Called when switching to the previous image, with the new index.

onRatioChange.zh-CN: 切换原始尺寸与适应页面时调用，参数为 `'adaptation'` 或 `'realSize'`。
onRatioChange.en-US: Called when switching between original size and fit-to-page, with `'adaptation'` or `'realSize'`.

onRotateLeft.zh-CN: 逆时针旋转图片时调用，参数为当前旋转角度。
onRotateLeft.en-US: Called when the image rotates counterclockwise, with the current rotation angle.

onVisibleChange.zh-CN: 可见状态变化时调用，参数为是否可见。
onVisibleChange.en-US: Called when the visibility changes, with whether the preview is visible.

onZoomIn.zh-CN: 图片放大时调用，参数为放大后的缩放比例。
onZoomIn.en-US: Called when the image zooms in, with the new zoom factor.

onZoomOut.zh-CN: 图片缩小时调用，参数为缩小后的缩放比例。
onZoomOut.en-US: Called when the image zooms out, with the new zoom factor.

originTip.zh-CN: 原始尺寸操作按钮的提示；未设置时取语言包的文案。
originTip.en-US: Tip of the original-size button; without it, the locale text is used.

preLoad.en-US: Whether to enable preloading, `true` by default.

preLoadGap.en-US: Step size of preloading, `2` by default.

previewCls.en-US: Custom class name of the preview layer.

previewStyle.en-US: Custom style of the preview layer.

previewTitle.zh-CN: 预览顶部标题，同时作为预览对话框的读屏名称；组内图片的 `preview.previewTitle` 优先。
previewTitle.en-US: Title at the top of the preview, also the accessible name of the preview dialog; the `preview.previewTitle` of an image in a group takes precedence.

prevTip.zh-CN: 上一张操作按钮的提示，同时作为读屏名称；未设置时取语言包的文案。
prevTip.en-US: Tip of the previous-image button, also its accessible name; without it, the locale text is used.

ref.zh-CN: 分组根 div 的引用。
ref.en-US: Reference to the group root div.

renderCloseIcon.zh-CN: 自定义关闭图标，可以是 React 元素，或返回 React 元素的函数。
renderCloseIcon.en-US: Custom close icon: a React element, or a function that returns one.

renderHeader.zh-CN: 自定义渲染预览顶部信息，接收当前标题，返回要显示的内容。
renderHeader.en-US: Renders the top area of the preview; it receives the current title and returns the content to show.

renderLeftIcon.zh-CN: 自定义向左切换图标，可以是 React 元素，或接收当前下标并返回 React 元素的函数。
renderLeftIcon.en-US: Custom previous-image icon: a React element, or a function that receives the current index and returns one.

renderPreviewMenu.zh-CN: 自定义渲染预览底部操作区，接收 MenuProps，返回要显示的内容。
renderPreviewMenu.en-US: Renders the bottom action area of the preview; it receives MenuProps and returns the content to show.

renderRightIcon.zh-CN: 自定义向右切换图标，可以是 React 元素，或接收当前下标并返回 React 元素的函数。
renderRightIcon.en-US: Custom next-image icon: a React element, or a function that receives the current index and returns one.

rotateTip.zh-CN: 旋转操作按钮的提示；未设置时取语言包的文案。
rotateTip.en-US: Tip of the rotate button; without it, the locale text is used.

setDownloadName.zh-CN: 设置图片下载文件名，接收图片地址并返回文件名。
setDownloadName.en-US: Sets the download file name: receives the image URL and returns the file name.

showTooltip.zh-CN: 是否展示底部操作区的提示，默认 `false`。
showTooltip.en-US: Whether to show tooltips on the bottom action area, `false` by default.

src.zh-CN: 要预览的图片地址列表。包裹 Image 时与各 Image 登记的预览图合并，src 中的图片排在前面。
src.en-US: Image URLs to preview. When wrapping Image components, it is merged with the preview images they register, with the src entries first.

style.zh-CN: 分组根 div 的样式。
style.en-US: Style of the group root div.

viewerVisibleDelay.zh-CN: 隐藏预览操作按钮前的无操作时长，单位为毫秒，默认 `10000`。
viewerVisibleDelay.en-US: Idle time in milliseconds before the preview action buttons hide, `10000` by default.

zIndex.en-US: z-index of the preview layer, `1070` by default.

zoomInTip.zh-CN: 放大操作按钮的提示；未设置时取语言包的文案。
zoomInTip.en-US: Tip of the zoom-in button; without it, the locale text is used.

zoomOutTip.zh-CN: 缩小操作按钮的提示；未设置时取语言包的文案。
zoomOutTip.en-US: Tip of the zoom-out button; without it, the locale text is used.

zoomStep.zh-CN: 每次缩小或放大的倍数，如 `0.1` 表示每次 10%，默认 `0.1`。
zoomStep.en-US: Zoom factor changed per zoom step, such as `0.1` for 10% per step, `0.1` by default.
